item.title: 🔵 MFA Prompt Bombing: Why Your Second Factor Isn't Saving You
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.

It meant that, even if an attacker possessed the account credentials, they couldn't log in without the second factor.
